dedupe_keys.name: madrid 3d building model lod2 from the municipal base cartography

description: Dirección General de Planificación Estratégica, Madrid City Council publishes a three-dimensional model of the buildings of the updated municipal base cartography, extruded from the roof lines of the buildings layer at scale 1:1000 to level of detail LOD2 with high geometric accuracy on the roofs; downloads are I3S/SLPK links, multipatch shapefiles and OBJ files grouped by district, with the 2D polygon layer 01_EDIFICIOS_P carrying the ID_3D key that also sits in the 3D geometries. Coverage: the city of Madrid; the portal lists the update frequency as undefined and the record was last modified on 2026-07-23. Format and access: I3S/SLPK, Shapefile (Multipatch), OBJ, downloadable without registration from the Madrid City Council open data portal (datos.madrid.es). Licence (read on the portal page on 2026-09-29): Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 (CC BY 4.0, legal code in Spanish on the portal); cost: free. Caveats: the model is roof geometry at LOD2 with no facade detail or interior information, the portal gives no update schedule, and the files were not opened. Simulation uses: 3D building geometry for urban microclimate, wind, solar and flood-exposure models and for city-scale digital twins and energy-demand modelling. Related catalogue records: Arbolado en parques y zonas verdes de Madrid (municipal tree inventory, yearly files) (data-madrid-arbolado-parques-zonas-verdes); OpenStreetMap (data-openstreetmap).
